title: Recent developments on arithmetic statistics of rational points on abelian varieties and curves
institution: Hausdorff School for Mathematics (HSM), University of Bonn
about: The Hausdorff School for Mathematics at the University of Bonn, Germany, holds the Special Topic School "Recent developments on arithmetic statistics of rational points on abelian varieties and curves" from 14 to 18 June 2027. Applications for participation are due 31 January 2027.
